name: Johnny Chute
role: Medora bartender and roller rink racer
bio: Johnny Chute was serving drinks at a Medora saloon in February 1885, and that spring he shot with the gun club and won races at the roller rink. In December 1886 the paper listed him among old-timers as last heard of in Helena.

moments.label: Won the potato race at the rink

mentions: …ent with his usual grace and urbanity and says he is bound to "fill up de boys" if he has to go dry to do it. Johnny Chute dishes up the lemonade to the boys and "Fitz" teaches them how to play a straight game of high low.
The Bad Lands Gun Club Shoot.
The prize in the potato race at the rink, last Saturday evening, was won by Johnny Chute. It was a good race, anyone being winner until the last potato was corralled.

The mile race at the rink last Saturday evening, was won by George Bicknell. In a sbsequent scrub race Johnny Chute beat the first time by over a minute making a mile in six minutes. As there were thirty-six laps to a mile this was fair time.
